name: release
author: Realmforge
description: The release at the end of a cast that formed a projectile (RLM-641, ADR 0073 decision 8; Matěj, 2026-10-29): from the cast's pose, hands together, both hands push forward and up and part as the projectile leaves, in a quarter of a second. The push is done by tick 2 and held a tick; from the end tick (3) to the stop tick (5) the arms ease back to rest. Its length is CastAnimation#RELEASE_TICKS, 5 ticks. Animates only the arms' rotations.
